name: freecut-desktop
description: 水管剪辑 — 我叫水管同学出品的开源桌面视频编辑器（FreeCut）
author: FreeCut contributors

scripts.test: vitest run src && node --test electron/*.test.cjs && node --test installer/backend.test.cjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-desktop.cjs && node scripts/regression-editor.cjs && node scripts/regression-context-menu.cjs && node scripts/regression-language.cjs && node scripts/regression-preview.cjs && node scripts/regression-home.cjs && node scripts/regression-keyframes.cjs && node scripts/regression-transform.cjs && node scripts/regression-audio.cjs && node scripts/regression-sounds.cjs && node scripts/regression-effects.cjs && node scripts/regression-update.cjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:ffmpeg && electron-builder --win dir portable --x64 --publish never && node scripts/package-installer.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:ffmpeg && electron-builder --mac --publish never
